rundgang.ausweis-ablegen.beschreibung: How to file an ID and get a reminder before it expires.
rundgang.ausweis-ablegen.ersatz: You create IDs under “+ New” as “ID document”.
rundgang.ausweis-ablegen.ende: Ablago reminds you 90 days before “Valid until” once you turn on “ID expiring soon” under Workbench → Automations.
rundgang.ausweis-ablegen.art.text: Choose ID card, passport, driving licence or another ID.
rundgang.ausweis-ablegen.art.ort: At the top of the form
rundgang.ausweis-ablegen.person.text: Choose the person from your household. That way you will find all IDs of a person later.
rundgang.ausweis-ablegen.person.ort: In the form below the type
rundgang.ausweis-ablegen.gueltig-bis.tex: Enter until when the ID is valid.
rundgang.ausweis-ablegen.original.text: Choose where you keep the paper, for example “Study › Cupboard › red folder”.
rundgang.ausweis-ablegen.original.ort: At the bottom of the form
rundgang.ausweis-ablegen.schreiben.text: File a letter as a document with the matter it is about – mail from the citizens’ office here, mail from your employer with the employment. If there is no such matter, file it with the sender.
rundgang.ausweis-ablegen.schreiben.ort: At the top in the “Documents” tab
tipp.einspruch: Enter “Objection by” on the notice. Then you won’t miss the deadline.
tipp.betrifft: Choose under “Concerns” what the notice is about – then it shows up there too, for example on the tax year.
